task_completion.description: Open the 'Fluorescent Cells (400K)' sample image in Fiji/ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Fiji/ImageJ window displays a multi-channel image titled 'Fluorescent Cells (400K)'.

task_completion.description: Split the image into individual Red and Green channels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Separate image windows for the Red channel (C1) and Green channel (C2) are visible on the workspace.

task_completion.description: Create a mask or selection based on the Green channel to define the cell area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A binary mask (black and white) or an active ROI selection is visible, corresponding to the cell structures in the Green channel.

task_completion.description: Perform the ratiometric calculation (Red / Green) using the Image Calculator or similar tool, restricted to the mask.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Image Calculator' dialog is used with the 'Divide' operation, or a new 32-bit image window appears showing the ratio result (often looks flatter or different in intensity than the raw channels).

task_completion.description: Save the resulting ratio image as a 32-bit TIFF to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a file explorer window shows 'ratio_map.tif' being saved to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/'.

task_completion.description: Measure the mean intensity of the ratio image and save it to 'mean_ratio.txt'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' table or 'Measure' output shows a 'Mean' value for the ratio image, and a text editor or terminal shows this value being saved to 'mean_ratio.txt'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji/ImageJ GUI menus and tools rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Fiji menus (e.g., Image > Stacks > Split Channels) and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the mean ratio value into the text file without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Results' window in Fiji must be visible and contain a value that matches the one written to the text file.

integrity.description: The agent performed the division operation within the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Image Calculator dialog or a Macro recorder window shows the 'Divide' operation being configured between the Red and Green channels.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The sample image 'Fluorescent Cells (400K)' is a standard Fiji sample. The Red channel is typically Channel 1 (C1) and the Green channel is Channel 2 (C2). The final output must be a 32-bit floating-point TIFF. The mean ratio value must be derived from the pixels within the green-channel-defined mask, where background pixels are excluded (0 or NaN). The expected output directory is /home/ga/ImageJ_Data/results/.
